verdict.rationale: Loops documents a no-code visual editor with editing guides and centralized brand themes (colors, type, spacing) that every email picks up automatically. It also documents per-recipient dynamic variables like {contact.firstName} that resolve at send time, and LMX/Content API authoring that stays in sync with the visual editor. Missing for 10: evidence of cross-client rendering correctness or testing, explicit documentation of a reusable template library (templates appear only in migration context), in-depth editor documentation, and independent hands-on corroboration of the editor.
